scope: Finite-grid synthetic strategy-preservation benchmark; first tranche before broader grid.

population.parameter_sampling: Independent discrete uniform draws from each listed support. Exact rare count rounded half-up and assigned by seeded permutation.

release_order.gate: Complete and report the six populations with all arms. Stage broader compute using measured full runtime; retain the frozen design regardless of result direction.

seeds.indexing: All indices zero-based in listed order.

neural_recipe.implementation: Project first-stage GRU adaptation documented in published-method-alignment.md
neural_recipe.primary_selection: Population mean observed-choice validation NLL, strict improvement, earliest tie retained.
neural_recipe.secondary_selection: Per-person observed-choice validation NLL, same trajectory and earliest tie.
neural_recipe.split: Independent seeded interspersed 60/20/20 masks per person.
neural_recipe.training_budget_basis: Retain the recipe fixed before notebook 06 for continuity and bounded compute. No test-score-based choice between its examined horizons.

baseline_recipe.within_family_prior: Uniform normalized within each family; average likelihood before estimating family weights.
baseline_recipe.fitting: First-stage observed training choices only. Group labels and true parameters reserved for scoring.

primary_outcome.contrast: Teacher-target student against solo, population-selected states
primary_outcome.prediction_gain: solo test NLL minus student test NLL
primary_outcome.behavioral_distortion: student signature RMS error minus solo signature RMS error
primary_outcome.report: Report both coordinates and their paired seed directions. Positive in both coordinates denotes better sampled prediction and worse strategy-assay fidelity.

behavioral_assay.history_bank: All 256 lexicographic binary two-trial histories, field order first_action,state,second_action,reward
behavioral_assay.signature: Exact probability of repeating the second first-stage action at the third choice, conditional on second-trial reward and transition. Weight histories by each fitted policy's own previous first-stage choices.
behavioral_assay.rms_error: Square root of the equally weighted mean of four squared differences from that person's generating-policy signature.
behavioral_assay.pull: Projection of fitted-minus-true signature onto true-majority-mean-minus-true signature, divided by squared norm of that direction. Denominator <=1e-12 gives null.
behavioral_assay.hierarchical_policy: Hold each person's training-posterior weights fixed. At each history average candidate action probabilities using those weights. Candidate value states follow that history. No persistent latent-candidate draw and no posterior updates from assay choices.

secondary_outcomes.diagnostic_reference: Hybrid weight 0.75 with the person's stage-two alpha and beta on the same history.
secondary_outcomes.probe_policy_kl: Mean KL(true Bernoulli || fitted Bernoulli) at the third choice, uniform over 256 fixed histories.

stopping_and_reporting.aggregation: Equal people within groups then equal populations. Unsupported diagnostics remain null with counts. Separate protocols and rare kinds.
stopping_and_reporting.stopping: Finish every planned arm at the fixed budget. Resume interrupted trajectories without resetting optimizer, RNG or selection. Numerical failures must be diagnosed and logged.
stopping_and_reporting.completion: Aggregate only a complete planned tranche; report interruptions explicitly.
stopping_and_reporting.inference: Descriptive means, ranges, and seed directions. Three populations per cell; no confirmatory significance declaration.
stopping_and_reporting.interpretation: Behavioral preservation requires agreement on the declared assay alongside conditional prediction. Short-history family uncertainty is reported.
stopping_and_reporting.future_changes: Amend protocol before new data are evaluated. Preserve all prior versions and outcomes. Off-grid populations, human data, extra capacities, teacher interventions and longer horizons need separate prospective designs.
